description: Three standalone display-text literals in one state-child body (newline- and space-separated, one interpolating; no `;` — §7.2.2 rule 2) render in order: `n is 5 and done`.
rationale: §4.18.3 (S444): a `"…"` is a display-text literal "only when it stands alone as a body statement — the whole statement is the one `"…"` (a body may hold several such statements; a `:`-shorthand body is one)".
